scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Theorem concerns the fixed two-parameter genus-three Ciani normal form over algebraically closed characteristic seven, and ordered F49 coefficient pairs, not geometric isomorphism classes. It gives no Newton polygon or other-prime classification. Symbolic algebraic proof and two replayable exact programs; unindexed prior arithmetic tables remain a priority risk.
title: Five Hasse-divisor components and seven transverse superspecial parameters for a characteristic-seven Ciani quartic family
